skill.name: figma-to-tailwind
skill.description: Convert Figma MCP design variables into standard Tailwind CSS classes for cleaner frontend implementation.
skill.summary: Turn Figma MCP variables into maintainable Tailwind CSS classes.
skill.author: Crearize

security_audit.summary: Static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around inline examples, fenced snippets, and file names. The entropy alert is also a false positive because SKILL.md is readable Markdown with Japanese prose and Tailwind examples, with no prompt injection or hidden payload found.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples trigger generic backtick execution scanners.
remediation.suggestion: No security fix is required. Consider scanner allowlisting for Markdown code spans when no executable script file is present.

remediation.issue: High entropy heuristic triggers on multilingual prose and dense code examples.
remediation.suggestion: No content change is required. Keep the skill as plain Markdown and avoid embedded encoded blobs or compressed data.

static_findings.snippet: - Figma MCPが生成したコードに`var(--spacing-*)`や`var(--width-*)`などの変数が含まれている場合
- `px-[var(--spacing-4)]`のようなFigma変数の直接使用を発見した場合
- インラインスタイルで`style={{ fontSize: 'var(--h4-font-size)' }}`のような記述を発見した場合
`frontend/lib/figma-tailwind-map.ts`を参照して、Figma変数がTailwind標準クラスに変換可能か確認します。
- 同じ色なら既存の変数を使用(例: `bg-primary`)
- [ ] インラインスタイルのフォント指定を`text-*`クラスに変換
- [ ] 標準にない値は`tailwind.config.ts`に追加
- **開発ガイド**: `documents/development/coding-rules/frontend-rules.md` セクション12

content.user_title: Convert Figma Variables to Tailwind CSS
content.value_statement: Figma MCP output can contain design variables and inline styles that are hard to maintain. This skill maps those values to standard Tailwind CSS classes and project tokens.
actual_capabilities: Maps Figma spacing variables to Tailwind spacing utilities.
Converts width and height variables to Tailwind size classes.
Replaces border radius variables with matching rounded classes.
Moves typography variable styles into configured text classes.
Guides color matching by comparing Figma HEX values with shadcn/ui tokens.
Shows how to add missing values to Tailwind and mapping files.
limitations: Requires Figma MCP output or existing code that contains Figma variables.
Depends on the project mapping file for reliable automatic conversion.
Color decisions still require HEX value comparison by the implementer.
Does not run lint, build, or visual tests by itself.

use_cases.title: Clean Generated Figma Code
use_cases.description: Convert generated variable-heavy markup into readable Tailwind classes after importing a design through Figma MCP.

use_cases.title: Standardize Design Token Usage
use_cases.description: Align spacing, sizing, radius, and typography values with existing Tailwind configuration and project conventions.

use_cases.title: Review Figma Variable Usage
use_cases.description: Find direct Figma variable usage during review and request standard Tailwind replacements before merge.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Basic Spacing
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner cleanup after Figma MCP generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this component for Figma spacing variables. Replace them with standard Tailwind spacing classes when the mapping is clear.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Layout Tokens
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate conversion for size and radius values.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert Figma width, height, spacing, and border radius variables in this component to Tailwind classes. Explain any unmapped values.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Typography Styles
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup of inline style output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace inline Figma typography variables with configured Tailwind text classes. Preserve visual hierarchy and list any assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Full Design Implementation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across generated UI code.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Figma MCP implementation for direct variables, inline styles, and unmapped tokens. Produce a concise conversion plan and final class choices.

output_examples.input: A generated component uses Figma spacing variables for padding and gaps.
output_examples.output: The spacing is replaced with matching Tailwind utilities, and unmapped values are listed for configuration review.

output_examples.input: A heading uses inline Figma typography variables for family, size, weight, and line height.
output_examples.output: The heading is converted to the closest configured text class, with visual intent preserved.

output_examples.input: A color variable name resembles an existing theme token but may not match exactly.
output_examples.output: The HEX value is compared before choosing an existing theme token or recommending a new custom token.

best_practices: Compare actual HEX and pixel values before choosing a Tailwind class.
Use existing project tokens before adding new custom values.
Run lint and build checks after conversion.
anti_patterns: Do not keep direct Figma variables in Tailwind arbitrary values.
Do not add custom utility classes when a Tailwind token already exists.
Do not choose color tokens by name similarity alone.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch designs from Figma?
faq.answer: No. It works after Figma MCP has provided design context or generated code.

faq.question: Can it convert spacing and sizing variables?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents mappings for spacing, width, height, and size-related Tailwind classes.

faq.question: How should colors be converted?
faq.answer: Compare the Figma HEX value with existing theme tokens before selecting or adding a class.

faq.question: Does it allow direct CSS variable usage?
faq.answer: It discourages direct Figma variable usage except for color cases that require project token handling.

faq.question: What happens when a value is not mapped?
faq.answer: Add the value to Tailwind configuration and the Figma-to-Tailwind mapping file before using it.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
